tagline: Aadhyatmik Yatra, Divya Anubhav aur Yaadgaar Safar ke saath

itinerary.title: Arrival & Vrindavan Temple Darshan
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1: Arrival & Banke Bihari Darshan
itinerary.description: Arrive in holy Vrindavan, settle into your accommodation, and experience divine evening darshan at Shri Banke Bihari Ji, Radha Raman Ji, and sacred Yamuna aarti at Keshi Ghat.
activities: Banke Bihari Ji & Radha Raman Ji Darshan
Evening Yamuna Aarti at Keshi Ghat

itinerary.title: Mathura Janmasthan & Sacred Gokul
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2: Krishna Janmabhoomi & Gokul Dham
itinerary.description: Visit the sacred birthplace of Lord Krishna at Shri Krishna Janmasthan in Mathura, attend Vishram Ghat Yamuna aarti, and explore holy Raman Reti and Nand Bhawan in Gokul.
activities: Gokul Dham, Nand Bhawan & Raman Reti

itinerary.title: Govardhan Parikrama & Barsana Dham
itinerary.subtitle: Day 3: Govardhan Parikrama & Radha Rani Temple
itinerary.description: Perform the sacred Govardhan Hill Parikrama with Dan Ghati darshan, meditate at holy Radha Kund & Shyam Kund, and visit Shri Radha Rani Mandir in Barsana.

itinerary.title: Heritage & Final Blessings
itinerary.subtitle: Day 4: Agra Heritage & Departure
itinerary.description: Witness the majestic morning view of the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort, followed by traditional Brajwasi souvenir shopping before your departure.
activities: Taj Mahal Sunrise View & Agra Fort

tagline: Discover Krishna Janmabhoomi, Yamuna Aarti & Sacred Gokul Dham

itinerary.title: Krishna Janmabhoomi & Yamuna Aarti
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1: Mathura Janmabhoomi & Vishram Ghat
itinerary.description: Begin your pilgrimage at the divine birthplace of Lord Krishna, offer prayers at historic Dwarkadhish Mandir, and attend the grand evening Yamuna Maha Aarti.
activities: Evening Yamuna Maha Aarti at Vishram Ghat

itinerary.title: Sacred Gokul, Raman Reti & Vrindavan
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2: Gokul, Raman Reti & Banke Bihari
itinerary.description: Explore the holy sand trails of Raman Reti where Lord Krishna played in childhood, visit Nand Bhawan, and conclude with blessings at Vrindavan's Banke Bihari Ji.
activities: Raman Reti Holy Sand & Chinta Haran
Banke Bihari Ji & ISKCON Temple Darshan

tagline: Perform Divine Goverdhan Parikrama & Visit Radha Rani's Barsana Dham

itinerary.title: Goverdhan Arrival, Mansi Ganga & Kusum Sarovar
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1: Goverdhan Arrival & Sacred Kunds
itinerary.description: Arrive in Govardhan Dham, take holy darshan of Mansi Ganga, and experience the twilight splendor of ancient sandstone chhatris at Kusum Sarovar.

itinerary.title: Sacred 21 KM Govardhan Parikrama
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2: Complete Govardhan Parikrama
itinerary.description: Embark on the divine 21 KM Govardhan Hill Parikrama via comfortable battery e-rickshaw or walking, visiting Dan Ghati and Mukharbind temples.

itinerary.title: Barsana Radha Rani Temple & Nandgaon
itinerary.subtitle: Day 3: Barsana Dham & Nandgaon Palace
itinerary.description: Climb the sacred Bhanugarh hill to visit Shri Radha Rani's palace temple in Barsana and explore Yashoda Nandan's home in Nandgaon.

tagline: Comprehensive Chaurasi Kos Darshan plus Agra Taj Mahal & Heritage Monuments

itinerary.title: Vrindavan Sacred Temples & Aarti
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1: Banke Bihari, Radha Raman & ISKCON
itinerary.description: Immerse in the devotion of Vrindavan with private VIP darshan at Banke Bihari Ji, Radha Raman, and attend evening aarti at Keshi Ghat.

itinerary.title: Mathura Janmasthan, Gokul & Raman Reti
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2: Krishna Janmabhoomi & Childhood Sites
itinerary.description: Visit the sacred jail sanctum at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, attend Vishram Ghat ceremonies, and explore holy Gokul Dham.

itinerary.title: Govardhan Hill Parikrama & Barsana
itinerary.subtitle: Day 3: Govardhan Parikrama & Radha Rani Temple
itinerary.description: Participate in the auspicious Govardhan Hill Parikrama, visit Dan Ghati temple, holy Radha Kund, and climb Barsana's Radha Rani temple.
activities: Radha Kund, Shyam Kund & Kusum Sarovar

itinerary.title: Agra World Heritage Taj Mahal & Fort
itinerary.subtitle: Day 4: Taj Mahal Sunrise & Agra Fort
itinerary.description: Experience the breathtaking sunrise view of the Taj Mahal, explore Agra Fort, and visit traditional artisanal marble inlay workshops.

itinerary.title: Kokilavan Shani Dev Dham & Final Blessings
itinerary.subtitle: Day 5: Kokilavan Parikrama & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit the renowned Kokilavan Shani Mandir for sacred parikrama and receive final auspicious Brajwasi blessings before departure.

tagline: Experience the divine temples, sacred ghats and spiritual atmosphere of Vrindavan Dham
includes: Private AC Vehicle for Local Sightseeing

itinerary.title: Divine Vrindavan Temple Darshan
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1: Banke Bihari, Radha Raman & Nidhivan
itinerary.description: Begin your spiritual journey in Vrindavan with darshan at the famous Banke Bihari Ji Temple, followed by Radha Raman Ji, Radha Vallabh Ji and the sacred Nidhivan area.
activities: Radha Raman Ji & Radha Vallabh Ji Darshan

itinerary.title: ISKCON, Prem Mandir & Yamuna Aarti
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2: Spiritual Vrindavan & Sacred Yamuna Ghats
itinerary.description: Explore the peaceful and beautiful side of Vrindavan with ISKCON Temple, Prem Mandir,  and an evening visit to the sacred Keshi Ghat for Yamuna Aarti.

itinerary.title: Govind Dev Ji, Rangji & Final Blessings
itinerary.subtitle: Day 3: Heritage Temples & Departure
itinerary.description: Complete your Vrindavan experience with the historic Govind Dev Ji Temple, Rangji Temple and other sacred sites before enjoying a relaxed departure transfer.
